title: StockSmart Storeroom Guidance — Draw Buffer from the Largest Single Vend of a Transferred Item
content:
A consigned StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines must hold enough to meet the largest draw the item has shown there.

**Rule.** The largest single vend of the transferred item ever recorded at the demand machine sets the draw buffer of the bin's reorder point: a largest vend of 4 units or more adds 2 units, a largest vend of 2 or 3 units adds 1 unit, and any smaller largest vend, or none at all, adds none.

The demand machine is the machine of the customer's most recent VendPoint selection removal of the item made at the customer's request. Every vend of the item there counts, whatever its date.

| Largest single vend at the demand machine | Draw buffer |
|---|---|
| 4 units or more | 2 units |
| 2 or 3 units | 1 unit |
| 1 unit | none |
| no vend on record there | none |

Hypothetical boundaries: a largest vend of exactly 4 units adds 2 units and one of 3 units adds 1; a largest vend of exactly 2 adds 1 unit and one of 1 adds none.
